pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with high edge angularity and sharp pixel-level gradients. Spatial area of dark regions is significantly larger than the separating light regions on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected graph of light-colored negative space with clearly defined junction nodes where three or more pathways meet. Pixel thickness of corridors is consistent and narrow relative to patch diameter.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette visible along the dorsal line of the neck and shoulder area.
